title.narrative: Gorenjska banka Senior Preffered bonds- MSME

description.narrative: An investment of €10 million in the senior preferred bonds issued by Gorenjska banka d.d. ("GB") issued on 22 November 2024 and listed on the Ljubljana Stock Exchange. The project is under the Financial Intermediaries Framework ("FIF"). The project (1) facilitates the expansion of the lending to MSMEs in the country and (2) supports the Bank's GET through promoting the financing of green technologies. GB will allocate 150% of EBRD's funds invested in the bond to finance MSME expansion and 100% of the funds to support GET-eligible projects. Additionally, the project has a broader objective of strengthening the resilience of Slovenia's financial sector by (i) supporting capital market development through increased bond issuances by Slovene banks and (ii) enhancing the loss-absorbing capacity of a systemic institution to ensure a continuous flow of credit within the economy.
